content: Validate-and-retry JSON repair pattern: Prompt→Generate→Validate→Repair→Parse. After implementing across 12 production LLM integrations: success rate improved from 60% to 97%, median +200ms latency per retry. Common issues: missing commas, unescaped quotes, truncated output, hallucinated fields, markdown code fences wrapping JSON, type coercions (string 'true' instead of bool true). JSON repair heuristics accumulate as special cases. For deeply nested schemas (5+ levels), prefer native structured output APIs. Max retries must be capped to prevent infinite loops; exponential backoff helps. Deterministic failure mode: after N retries, raise a structured error rather than returning partial/invalid output.
